Create a basic response using the Responses API

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var requestJson = "{\"input\":\"Explain quantum computing in one sentence.\",\"model\":\"gpt-4o\"}";
        var request = JsonUtil.fromJson(requestJson, CreateResponseRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.createResponse(request);
        System.out.println(result.id());
        System.out.println(result.status());
        System.out.println(result.output());
        }
    }
}
```
